question: Can a stock nominal 2 mm tubular spacer be added as a compression limiter to the current nominal 2 mm yaw shelf without controlling paired thickness?
scope: Necessary axial seating geometry before hole changes, preload assignment, or FE
criterion: The metal limiter must not hold the plate and washer apart while leaving the plastic unclamped; allowable plastic compression is not yet specified
stop: Read eight existing CAD interface separations and evaluate the published spacer length extremes once. If even the nominal shelf cannot always be clamped, do not create a release CAD or preload FE.
spacer_catalog: SP-S2, L=2 mm, SUS303, OD4 / ID2.2 mm, L tolerance +/-0.1 mm
spacer_role: Off-the-shelf pipe-spacer dimensional comparison, NOT a load-rated compression limiter
